question: Can a completely unseen third raw surface family acquire only a context-derived representation and then use transition knowledge learned from two other surface families without any task-transition examples of its own?
hypothesis: With the unchanged zero-shot scientific design, a raw bridge learner over three surface families will recover twenty-seven recurrent surface motifs and induce exactly nine three-member contextual alias classes. A class-transition learner trained only on task records from families 0 and 1 will achieve at least 0.95 semantic accuracy on all eighty family-2 single-step tasks, while exact-surface has all eighty family-2 transition keys missing and at most 0.25 accuracy, and the frozen shuffled-family2 bridge remains at or below 0.25.

supersedes_invalid_before_execution.reason: direct qualification rejected a four-commit baseline-to-head delta before science
its actual preregistration parent differed from its declared exact_parent_sha during scheduler shutdown
pre-execution validity text contained a stale R2 identifier; no scientific output was produced

scientific_reuse.allowed_difference: R4 result identifier and qualification wrapper only
scientific_reuse.forbidden: changes to families, bridge, task corpus, family-2 isolation, controls, metrics, thresholds, clustering, or prediction

prior_qualified_evidence.observation: Two-family contextual alias induction recovered nine correct classes and reached 1.0 cross-family accuracy while exact-surface scored 0.03125 and shuffled-context 0.15.

authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
R4 delegates to the unchanged R1 scientific function and changes only result identity/qualification wrapper.
Family 2 has zero task-transition training records and appears only in the raw bridge before evaluation.
Clustering receives no family label, semantic label, alias mapping, or evaluator dictionary.
Exact-surface and shuffled-family controls are unchanged from R1.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution and all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and unseen-family accuracy materially exceeds both controls, but at least one representation recovery or 0.95 threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but unseen-family transfer does not materially outperform the exact-surface control.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents complete frozen evaluation.
classification_rules.invalid: Any provenance, scientific-function drift, family-2 task leakage, bridge leakage, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No scientific input, learner, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
